newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound steady against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was steady against the dollar in the private market on Sunday and bankers said last week's dollar shortage was easing.
Bankers had said last week that public sector banks were heavily borrowing dollars to wrap up their accounts before the end of the fiscal year. The year ends on June 30.
"The market is not as bad as it used to be. The shortage is easing and it's moderate," one banker said.
Private-sector bankers said the dollar ranged from 3.3950 to 3.3980 pounds bid and from 3.3975 to 3.3985 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of six actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3964 pounds bid and 3.3981 pounds offered. These averages compare to 3.3968 pounds bid and 3.3981 offered on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.393891 buy and 3.398817 sell.
